mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.last_message_content, s.last_message_time, CASE WHEN s.user_a = #{userId} AND s.user_a_type = #{userType} THEN s.unread_a ELSE s.unread_b END AS unread_count, CASE WHEN s.user_a = #{userId} AND s.user_a_type = #{userType} THEN s.user_b ELSE s.user_a END AS peer_id, CASE WHEN s.user_a = #{userId} AND s.user_a_type = #{userType} THEN s.user_b_type ELSE s.user_a_type END AS peer_type, COALESCE(pu.nickname, su.nick_name) AS peer_nickname, COALESCE(pu.avatar, su.avatar) AS peer_avatar FROM portal_message_session s LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = (CASE WHEN s.user_a = #{userId} AND s.user_a_type = #{userType} THEN s.user_b ELSE s.user_a END) AND (CASE WHEN s.user_a = #{userId} AND s.user_a_type = #{userType} THEN s.user_b_type ELSE s.user_a_type END) = 'portal' LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = (CASE WHEN s.user_a = #{userId} AND s.user_a_type = #{userType} THEN s.user_b ELSE s.user_a END) AND (CASE WHEN s.user_a = #{userId} AND s.user_a_type = #{userType} THEN s.user_b_type ELSE s.user_a_type END) = 'sys' WHERE (s.user_a = #{userId} AND s.user_a_type = #{userType}) OR (s.user_b = #{userId} AND s.user_b_type = #{userType}) ORDER BY s.last_message_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO portal_message_session (user_a, user_a_type, user_b, user_b_type, unread_a, unread_b, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userA}, #{userAType}, #{userB}, #{userBType}, 0, 0, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
